latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of agent-id.

- Enables persistent, cross-platform identity for agents.
- Generates an agent identity card with name, capabilities, and contact endpoints.
- Emits OADP discovery signals for trusted findability by other agents.
- Supports registration on open coordination hubs like ClawSwarm.
- Includes setup instructions for making any agent OADP-discoverable.
